name: Heidi A. Tallentire
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in New York, New York
about: Attorney Heidi A. Tallentire is a partner at Krauss Shaknes Tallentire & Messeri LLP in New York, New York. Ms. Tallentire concentrates her practice on family law, representing clients throughout the New York City metropolitan area, particularly executives in the finance industry and other wealthy individuals.

Ms. Tallentire handles matters involving high net worth divorces, child support, custody, prenuptial agreements, postnuptial agreements, spousal support and visitation. She has over a decade of experience and has focused her practice exclusively on family law throughout her legal career.

Prior to joining Krauss Shaknes Tallentire & Messeri LLP, Ms. Tallentire was a partner at a national family law firm. In addition to managing her law practice, she is an adjunct professor at Rutgers Law School, Newark’s S.I. Newhouse Center for Law and Justice, teaching family law courses.

Dedicated to giving back to her community, Ms. Tallentire is involved in nonprofit organizations and sits on the board of Sheltering Arms, an organization aimed at helping New York families in need. She is a former board member of Weston United, an organization helping homeless and mentally ill New York residents.

Ms. Tallentire graduated with distinction from the University of Pennsylvania with a bachelor’s degree and a master’s degree. She earned her law degree from the University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School. She holds a license to practice law in the state courts of New York and Connecticut, as well as before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 2nd Circuit and the Supreme Court of the United States.
